name: Root of Trust
purpose: Hardware trust anchor boot verification measurement and the smallest pre-kernel transfer mechanism
default_authority: Verify measure recover and transfer control only
input_rule: Accept only fixed-format authenticated boot metadata and measured platform state
failure_rule: Reject before transfer preserve known-good recovery and expose no runtime command surface
required_evidence: Wrong-key corruption rollback measurement and runtime-reentry tests plus executable-page and symbol inventory

name: Trusted Kernel Core
purpose: Scheduler MMU IPC capability validation fault routing interrupt routing and resource-budget enforcement
default_authority: Only the platform mechanisms required to isolate and mediate lower classes
input_rule: Parse no packet file executable document model or variable-length device format
failure_rule: Contain or terminate the faulting domain without enlarging authority or violating RT reserves
required_evidence: Active address-space W-X guard-page fault-containment capability non-bypass WCET and privileged-TCB inventory evidence

name: Isolated System Service
purpose: Drivers network and storage stacks loaders crypto brokers and device-facing services
default_authority: Start empty and receive only typed service device DMA IRQ MMIO or endpoint capabilities
input_rule: Assume every device response packet object and client request is hostile
failure_rule: Terminate revoke reset and restart without stale memory DMA IRQ queue or capability state
required_evidence: Compromise restart hot-unplug malicious-DMA parser exhaustion and negative unselected-component evidence

name: Sandboxed Application
purpose: Signed installed applications local inference runtimes shells and administrative tools
default_authority: Start empty and receive only the policy-approved subset of the signed manifest request
input_rule: All application inputs and peer messages remain untrusted regardless of signer
failure_rule: Terminate and revoke all grants without changing another domain or the immutable system
required_evidence: Empty-launch manifest-subset cross-process isolation resource-budget teardown and provenance evidence

name: Hostile Transient Domain
purpose: Downloads unknown executables disposable parsers renderers scripts documents and model output
default_authority: Zero ambient authority with only one-shot input and result channels explicitly granted by a broker
input_rule: Treat all bytes prompts generated actions and retained state as attacker controlled
failure_rule: Kill discard quarantine outputs and forbid in-place promotion or persistence
required_evidence: Exploit-corpus fuzz quarantine no-execute clean-destroy promotion-recreate and adaptive-campaign evidence
